sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'Pinball Wizard' is a classic pinball game that requires players to use flippers to bounce a ball around a table, scoring points and collecting rewards along the way. The game features a variety of tables, each with its unique layout, obstacles, and challenges. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new tables, each with its own set of rules and objectives.

 The game's physics engine is incredibly realistic, making it feel like you're actually playing on a real pinball machine. The ball behaves just like it would in a real game, bouncing off walls, flippers, and other obstacles with precision and accuracy. This level of realism makes 'Pinball Wizard' feel incredibly immersive, drawing you in and making you feel like you're a part of the game.

 One of the key features of 'Pinball Wizard' is its use of power-ups and bonuses to enhance gameplay. As you collect these rewards, you'll unlock special abilities, such as extra balls, speed boosts, and score multipliers. These power-ups can be a game-changer, turning the tide of the game in your favor and helping you achieve your goals. With so many power-ups to collect, you'll never know what's around the next corner, making the game feel fresh and exciting every time you play.
